questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Well, I love the US, and I chose Berkeley because of its prestige.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: I think it was okay.

questions.answer: I received emails and orientation.

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: There were dorms, and I lived at the International House.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: There was a meal plan at the International House.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Its very expensive, and most of the dorms are pretty disgusting and mostly inhabited by freshmen. I would choose the International House if you can afford it, otherwise I would look into a co-op.

questions.answer: You do it through a website.

questions.answer: There was a guide and some emails. Maybe also a zoom meeting.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Choose classes outside your field, I regret not doing that.

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: It was a little low, but that is because an American college education is less specialized, so people have less experience in the specific fields.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was good.

Muslim Literature

questions.answer: The superficiality.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1. It is expensive so apply for grants. 2. The campus culture is amazing. 3. Consider doing two semesters.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The academic level is not that high, so don't be daunted by the name.

questions.answer: Living in a campus enviroment.

questions.answer: Maybe speaking english in the beginning.
